children: Hallador Energy entered into a new Credit Agreement providing a $600 million senior secured term loan facility, led by Kennedy Lewis Investment Management, to fund turbines, expand gas plant capacity, acquire equipment and refinance existing debt. The facility funded $550 million at closing with a $50 million delayed draw available for 12 months, and permits a separate up to $75 million first-lien revolver from commercial banks. The term loan matures in three years with a two-year extension option and features a 100% excess cash flow sweep after COD, covenant tests, and a 2.5% commitment fee. Pre-COD interest includes a cash pay component and PIK margin; post-COD interest is SOFR plus 8.00% in cash with a 3.5% SOFR floor.
: Senior secured term loan facility with delayed draw and permitted first-lien revolver
: Kennedy Lewis Investment Management and other lenders
: Fund turbines, plant expansion, equipment and refinance existing debt
